integrationReview.reason: All services validate student/teacher/operator identity via JWTs issued by auth-microservice before granting access to protected course, assessment, and payment APIs.
integrationReview.contract: JWT validation on protected routes across all 42xx services and api-gateway
integrationReview.configuration: Service URL and JWT validation middleware per NestJS service
integrationReview.failureMode: Requests without a valid JWT are rejected; protected endpoints remain unavailable until auth-microservice recovers.
integrationReview.validation: Auth-protected route smoke checks confirm JWT validation is enforced per service.

integrationReview.reason: Each service (content, certification, assessment, course, education, user, payment, notification, salary, financial) persists its domain data in its own speakasap_*_db PostgreSQL database.
integrationReview.configuration: DATABASE_URL per service, provisioned via database-server:5432
integrationReview.failureMode: A database outage blocks the affected service's reads/writes; other services remain isolated by per-service DB ownership.
integrationReview.validation: Per-service Prisma migration status and connectivity checks.

integrationReview.reason: Services share a Redis cache via database-server:6379 for session/cache data as documented in SYSTEM.md.
integrationReview.contract: Shared Redis cache access via database-server:6379
integrationReview.failureMode: Cache unavailability degrades performance but does not lose durable data held in PostgreSQL.

integrationReview.reason: All services publish centralized structured logs to logging-microservice:3367.
integrationReview.contract: POST structured log payloads per the platform logging contract
integrationReview.configuration: Logging service URL configured per service
integrationReview.failureMode: Logging outage degrades observability without blocking service operation.

integrationReview.reason: notification-service dispatches student/teacher email, Telegram, and WhatsApp notifications via notifications-microservice:3368.
integrationReview.contract: Notification dispatch API for transactional student/teacher messages
integrationReview.configuration: Notification channel and template configuration in notification-service
integrationReview.failureMode: Notification failures are retried/logged; course and payment operations are not blocked by a notification outage.

integrationReview.reason: AI-orchestrated grammar drill generation and validation agents (part of the drilling-assignments feature) call ai-microservice:3380, per SYSTEM.md.
integrationReview.contract: AI inference calls for drill generation/validation with constrained content-safety prompts
integrationReview.configuration: AI service endpoint and model selection configured per calling service
integrationReview.failureMode: AI outage degrades AI-authored drill generation; existing drill content and manual workflows remain available.
integrationReview.validation: Targeted AI smoke tests for drill generation/validation agents.

integrationReview.reason: payment-service delegates all course payment processing to payments-microservice:3468; this is an explicit business constraint (no direct payment processing in speakasap).
integrationReview.contract: Payment initiation/capture requests delegated to payments-microservice
integrationReview.failureMode: Payment processing is unavailable until payments-microservice recovers; no local fallback payment path exists by design.
integrationReview.validation: Payment delegation smoke tests against payments-microservice.

integrationReview.reason: SpeakASAP is an education platform with its own course/content data model; it does not use the e-commerce product catalog domain.
Course enrollment and payment are handled within speakasap and payments-microservice; there is no e-commerce order-processing integration.
SpeakASAP has no physical inventory or warehouse concern.
Course payments are financial transactions handled by payments-microservice; no proforma/tax invoice workflow exists in this repository.

education-service stores teacher lesson recordings via a MinIO-backed storage service (`education-service/src/lesson-records/storage.service.ts`), and k8s manifests reference the minio-microservice Vault secret.
integrationReview.contract: Object storage for lesson-recording audio files via MinIO S3-compatible API
integrationReview.configuration: MinIO endpoint and credentials pulled from Vault `secret/prod/minio-microservice` via ESO into education-service
integrationReview.failureMode: Storage outage blocks new lesson-recording uploads/downloads; existing course/assessment data is unaffected.
integrationReview.validation: Lesson-recording upload/download smoke checks against the storage service.

integrationReview.reason: No RabbitMQ/AMQP client usage was found in the repository; services integrate via direct HTTP calls to other microservices rather than the shared event bus.
The repository must remain discoverable through the ecosystem documentation index for bounded-context discovery, as already referenced in AGENTS.md.
integrationReview.contract: Direct Git repository ingestion and repository-scoped retrieval
integrationReview.configuration: Tracked in the canonical repository registry and docs-RAG index
integrationReview.failureMode: When docs-RAG is unavailable, Git remains authoritative per AGENTS.md.
integrationReview.validation: Repository documents resolve to the owning repository path and remain discoverable.

integrationReview.reason: Runtime health and rollout readiness for all 12+ services must be observable through the shared monitoring stack.
integrationReview.contract: GET /health and Kubernetes readiness probes per service
integrationReview.configuration: Deployment probes and health endpoints per service manifest
integrationReview.failureMode: An unhealthy service fails rollout readiness and is surfaced to the owner via monitoring.
integrationReview.validation: Monitoring stack confirms health/readiness per deployed service.

integrationReview.reason: Per-service PostgreSQL databases are backed up via backups-microservice scripts, as referenced in the drilling-assignments rollout docs (`backups-microservice/scripts/backup-db.sh <db-name>`).
integrationReview.contract: Scheduled/manual PostgreSQL backups per speakasap_*_db database
integrationReview.configuration: backup-db.sh invoked with each service database name
integrationReview.failureMode: Missed backups increase data-loss risk on failure; this must be flagged as an operational blocker if backup automation lapses.
integrationReview.validation: Backup script execution and restore-drill evidence.
